entries.note: Independent i18n audit of the nine keys this PR added to wire.remote_compute (run_limit, run_busy, refusal_conflict, repo_no_remote, repo_not_https_remote, repo_unpushed_commit, tier_cloud_run, tier_dedicated, option_spot), each value read in full against the en source and catalogues/en/wire.remote_compute.context.json, at head 217ccff46f5b in .worktrees/rc-client-core. DELTA PROOF (so this row does not claim the 43 carried values as freshly read): `git diff origin/main..217ccff46f5b` on en and on each of the seven locales adds exactly these 9 keys, 0 changed, 0 removed, and the previous passed row's source_sha256 d1d9119a235c1a8c09306f42438115f5211ede16addf80a8f88d6f78860367a8 equals origin/main's en bytes; those 43 values are the bytes that row already audited and are byte-identical here. MECHANICAL, 63 values: key parity 52/52 in every locale; {detail} is the only placeholder and appears exactly once in each value that has it; ICU parse clean; NFC; no Cc/Cf characters (no bidi controls, per the ur guide); no leading/trailing padding. Tier labels inside the context sidecar's 24-cell budget, measured with rich.cells.cell_len (cloud_run/dedicated/spot): fr 15/5/4, es 20/8/4, zh-CN 8/4/4, ru 15/10/4, hi 7/5/3, ur 8/5/5, vi 21/11/4. MEANING against the sidecar roles: run_limit reads as a concurrency ceiling and never as credit, billing or idempotency; run_busy reads correctly for a run or a workload; refusal_conflict names no idempotency key (the misreading this PR removes); the repo_* values state the fact first and put the remedy last; tier_cloud_run never says spot; tier_dedicated never mentions spot; option_spot reads as an opt-in capacity under Dedicated, not as a tier. TERMINOLOGY reuses the namespace's shipped renderings: run = exécution / ejecución / 运行 / запуск / रन / رن / lần chạy; remote compute = calcul distant / cómputo remoto / 远程计算 / удалённые вычисления / रिमोट कंप्यूट / ریموٹ کمپیوٹ / tính toán từ xa; commit/push stay English per glossary §2's kept-English set (fr/es/ru/vi) and Latin (zh-CN/hi/ur); Radient, origin, https:// and SSH are untouched in every locale. Register per guide: fr vous with U+202F before : ; es tú; zh-CN 请 on each refusal's next-step clause; ru вы; hi आप; ur آپ; vi drops bạn and uses plain verbs. No finding. "công việc đám mây" for cloud work and "khối lượng công việc" for workload are accepted (tác vụ is the recorded vi job term and this sentence is about concurrent work); "thông tin đăng nhập" for a credential-free URL follows this namespace's shipped api_override and mobile.setup/tunnel.status, which use it for login credentials while thông tin xác thực names the stored secret; bạn is dropped in favour of plain verbs; "Lần chạy trên đám mây" (21 cells) / "Chuyên dụng" / "Spot" are the labels. Verdict: CLEAN, 0 blocker/major open. Native-speaker review and rendered-frame certification are not claimed; the width figures are cell measurements, not terminal screenshots. Evidence: this receipt; the rendering check quoted on the PR.
